title: Muddy River Midnight
mood_ko: 레조네이터 기타 · 연기 낀 한밤의 블루스 바
style: deep delta blues, slow 12/8 shuffle, 68 bpm, gritty slide guitar on resonator, wailing blues harmonica, upright bass, brushed drums, warm hammond organ, raspy soulful male vocal, smoky late-night juke joint, raw analog warmth, studio recording
exclude: live, live recording, concert, crowd noise, audience, applause, lo-fi, pop, edm, autotune
lyrics:
[Intro: Slow Slide Guitar]
Mmm... yeah...

[Verse 1]
Well, the river's runnin' muddy and the moon done lost its shine
Yeah, the river's runnin' muddy and the moon done lost its shine
I been waitin' at this crossroad, Lord, with nothin' but my wine

[Verse 2]
She took the last train northbound, left her red dress on the chair
She took the last train northbound, left her red dress on the chair
Now every note I'm bendin' still smells like her in the air

[Chorus]
Muddy river midnight, carry my blues away
Muddy river midnight, I ain't got no more to say
Roll on, roll on, 'til the break of day

[Harmonica Solo]

[Verse 3]
I got a six-string sorrow and a heart that's black and blue
I got a six-string sorrow and a heart that's black and blue
Every road I travel, baby, only leads me back to you

[Chorus]
Muddy river midnight, carry my blues away
Muddy river midnight, I ain't got no more to say
Roll on, roll on, 'til the break of day

[Outro]
Roll on, muddy river...
Roll on...

[Slide Guitar Fade Out]
[End]

깊은 밤 듣는 짙은 블루스 | Deep delta blues for late nights.
슬라이드 기타와 하모니카, 거친 목소리로 채운 한밤의 블루스. 화면 가사와 함께 들어 보세요.

video: Cinematic 16:9 music video shot, single continuous take, locked-off camera on a tripod at chest height, medium-wide framing. A weathered bluesman in his 60s with a gray beard, a worn felt fedora and rolled-up shirt sleeves sits on a wooden stool at the center of the frame, playing slow slide blues on a shiny resonator guitar: the glass slide gliding along the strings, his foot tapping slowly, head nodding with eyes half closed. He stays seated and centered the whole time. Setting: a dim, smoky Mississippi juke joint at midnight, a single bare amber bulb above him, deep blue light spilling through a rain-streaked window behind him, cigarette-style haze drifting through the light, old wooden walls. The lower third of the frame is a dark worn wooden floor. Moody deep blue and amber palette, heavy shadows, rich film grain, melancholic soulful mood, 24fps film look. No cuts, no camera movement, no text, no logos, no signs with letters, no other people entering or leaving the frame.
